description: Tricks: prepare (unsigned) a Safehouse on one of YOUR crews (approve the exact price first): 24 game-hours of immunity to tricks and squad raids, plus one Burner Phone armed if none is. At most 2 per wallet per 7 game days. All the ZENI goes to the reward pool. Refused with the reason if tricks are not live or the crew is already safe.

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.
